title: Engineering Decision Table — The Metering Coverage Share of a Verified Saving, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Metering Coverage Share of a Verified Saving

Decision table for the coverage share applied when savings are verified on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The full coverage share is 100 percent, the near complete coverage share 95 percent and the partial coverage share 85 percent.

## Rule

- Where the metered points the subscription covers reach the points the tier includes and the site posted an interval reading in the month ending on the day of the verification for every point the subscription covers, the coverage share is the full coverage share.
- Where the metered points the subscription covers reach the points the tier includes but fewer interval readings were posted in that month than the points covered, the coverage share is the near complete coverage share.
- In every other case the coverage share is the partial coverage share.

## Table

| Metered points the subscription covers, against the points the tier includes | Interval readings posted in the month ending on the day of the verification | Coverage share |
|---|---|---|
| at or above the included count | at least one for every point covered | 100 percent |
| at or above the included count | fewer than the points covered | 95 percent |
| below the included count | any | 85 percent |

The readings counted are those posted from the interval meters, placed by the day they were posted.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

A subscription at a tier including 12 points covers 12 and posted 12 interval readings in the month: 100 percent. The same subscription with 11 readings posted: 95 percent. A subscription covering 11 points where the tier includes 12: 85 percent, whatever was posted.
